title: ethclient: expose blob fee history fields
body:
# Rationale

The `eth_feeHistory` RPC response includes `baseFeePerBlobGas` and
`blobGasUsedRatio`, but `ethclient.FeeHistory` currently discards these
fields because they are absent from its decoding struct and the public
`ethereum.FeeHistory` type.

Exposing these fields would let Go applications access historical blob
fees and usage ratios for fee estimation and monitoring without using
raw RPC calls and custom response types.

# Implementation

Add `BlobBaseFee` and `BlobGasUsedRatio` to `ethereum.FeeHistory` and
populate them from the corresponding RPC fields in `ethclient.FeeHistory`.

Keep the slices nil when a server omits the fields, and preserve
explicitly empty arrays as empty slices.

Include tests for populated, omitted, and empty fields, as well as
blob fee values larger than uint64.

I have submitted an implementation in #35725
